title: GitHub Query Quote Handling
description: Why quotes may only open at the start of a token or after a colon.
body: A quote only opens at the start of a token or straight after a colon. Opening on a quote character anywhere would be wrong for the commonest thing anyone types: in `it's broken is:pr`, the apostrophe would open a quote that never closes. Restricting where a quote may open costs nothing real and leaves an apostrophe inside a word alone.
